summary: Coin has no designer guide for Image; use its facts from the package types.

examples.purpose: A 16 : 9 image with an accessible label.

props.name: imageSource
props.description: Image source. Accepts the same shapes as React Native's `<Image>` plus a raw URL string. Naming is intentionally aligned with `Avatar`, `ProductLabel`, `CardProviderInfo`, etc. so the library has a single, predictable image-source prop name.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width-to-height aspect ratio as a number, e.g. `16 / 9`, `1`, `4 / 3`. Defaults to `16 / 9` so the image always has a sensible rendered height even when the parent has no fixed height (e.g. inside `MediaCard`, which hugs whatever the image renders at). Pass `ratio={null as any}` is not supported — explicitly set a number, or override with `width` + `height` if you need a non-aspect layout. Equivalent CSS: `aspect-ratio: <ratio>`. Default 1.7778 (16 / 9), from the component source.

props.name: resizeMode
props.description: How the image is fit inside its box. Defaults to `'cover'`. Default "cover", from the component source.

props.name: resizeMethod
props.description: (Android only) How the bitmap is resampled when the source resolution differs from the rendered box. RN's own default is `'auto'`, which for large source images silently picks `'resize'`: a pre-decode software downsample that DESTROYS detail and makes big hero/background images look soft/pixelated even when the asset is high-res. To avoid that, this component defaults to: - `'none'` when an explicit `width` + `height` box is set (full-bleed hero/background usage — full resolution, maximum sharpness), and - `'scale'` otherwise (GPU scaling — high quality and memory-safe for ordinary aspect-ratio images). Pass an explicit value to override. No-op on iOS/web.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional explicit width. If omitted and a `ratio` is set, the image defaults to `width: '100%'` so it fills its parent.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional explicit height. Usually you only need `ratio` instead.

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Border radius applied to the image (clips the underlying raster).

props.name: style
props.description: Style merged onto the underlying RN `<Image>`.

props.name: accessibilityElementsHidden
props.description: Hide from the a11y tree (e.g. when image is purely decorative).

props.name: loading
props.description: Explicit per-instance loading override. When `true`, the image renders as a skeleton placeholder at the same box size; when `false`, the surrounding `<SkeletonGroup>` is ignored. Defaults to inheriting from the group.

props.name: cache
props.description: iOS URL cache strategy applied to remote (`{ uri }`) sources. Injected into the RN `source.cache` field so callers don't have to re-shape the source object themselves. No-op for local/required assets and on Android/web.

props.name: onLoad
props.description: Called when the image finishes loading successfully. Forwarded straight to RN's `<Image onLoad>`.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called when the image fails to load. Forwarded straight to RN's `<Image onError>`.

events.name: onLoad
events.description: Called when the image finishes loading successfully. Forwarded straight to RN's `<Image onLoad>`.

events.name: onError
events.description: Called when the image fails to load. Forwarded straight to RN's `<Image onError>`.
